expectations.text: Processing only on the controller's documented instructions (Art. 28(3)(a)), including for transfers
expectations.evidence: Clause 3: "process personal data only on documented instructions from Controller, including regarding international transfers"

expectations.text: Confidentiality commitments for persons authorised to process (Art. 28(3)(b)) and Art. 32 security measures (Art. 28(3)(c))
expectations.evidence: Clause 4 confidentiality for authorized personnel; Clause 5 Art. 32 security: encryption, access controls, restore availability, regular testing

expectations.text: Sub-processor rules: prior specific or general written authorisation, notification of changes, and flow-down of equivalent obligations (Art. 28(2), (4))
expectations.evidence: Clause 6: "prior specific or general written authorisation... right to object to new sub-processors, a current sub-processor list... flow-down of equivalent obligations"

expectations.text: Assistance obligations: data subject rights requests and Arts. 32–36 (security, breach notification, DPIA) assistance (Art. 28(3)(e), (f)), with processor breach notification to the controller without undue delay (Art. 33(2))
expectations.evidence: Clauses 7-8: assistance with Art. 15-22 requests and Art. 32-36 (security, breach, DPIA); Clause 11: breach notification "without undue delay" within 24-48h

expectations.text: End-of-contract deletion or return of data, and audit/inspection rights including information necessary to demonstrate compliance (Art. 28(3)(g), (h))
expectations.evidence: Clause 9: delete or return all data at termination incl. backups; Clause 10: "Right to audit or inspect the provider's compliance" or accept certifications/reports demonstrating compliance
